title: Search Syntax: click an example to try it
problem: The Search Syntax dialog is a static table: eleven rows of plain text with no handlers (src/finder/dialogs.rs:949-1008). It is opened from the (i) in the search scope bar, in the middle of a search (src/finder/bars.rs:139-157), or with Cmd+/. To try `git:modified`, `!*.log  !test` or `src/**/*.rs`, the user has to memorise the text, close the dialog and retype it. The first row also says '(typos allowed in Settings)' whatever the Allow typos switch is set to (dialogs.rs:950-953).
proposal: In `search_help`: give the nine query rows (all but 'Kind menu' and 'Contents') `.id(("syntax-row", ix))`, `.cursor_pointer()`, a hover background and `.test_support()`. On click: close the dialog, set the search field to the example with `search_input.update(cx, |s, cx| s.set_value(example, window, cx))`, and focus the field with everything selected, as `focus_search` does (src/finder/mod.rs:1485-1490). The field's `Change` event already runs the search through `on_search_event` (mod.rs:1304-1306). Change the muted footer to start with 'Click an example to try it.' Build the first row's text from `config.search.typos`: 'typos allowed' or 'typos off in Settings'.
original_test_plan: Headless UI test in tests/controls.rs, near the existing `help-done` check at line 393: press Cmd+/, click `("syntax-row", 2usize)` (the `*.pdf  *.md` row). Assert the dialog is closed and the search is active, and that every name in `ui.names()` ends in `.pdf` or `.md` (the fixture has `Roadmap.md`). Turn Allow typos off with `update_search_settings`, reopen the dialog, and assert the first row's text says typos are off.
original_risks: Clicking replaces whatever was in the search field. Selecting the inserted text keeps that cheap to undo by typing. Some examples (`/notes/ todo`, `main.rs:42`) find nothing in most folders, which could read as broken; either leave those rows unclickable or accept an empty result. The first-row wording follows the Allow typos switch added in the Unreleased section.

verifier.claim_check:
The problem is real, but the proposal's mechanism is wrong in two places and it adds a hazard.

**True today**
- `search_help` (src/finder/dialogs.rs:942-1008) renders `const ROWS: [(&str, &str); 11]` (949-976) as plain `h_flex()` rows (986-998) with no id, hover or handler. The only control is the Done button (1006).
- The first row's text "(typos allowed in Settings)" is a constant (950-953). It was written that way on purpose in 66c919b and can be read as a pointer to Settings, so this part is cosmetic.
- The (i) button is at src/finder/bars.rs:139-158, and the scope bar only renders while searching (src/finder/mod.rs:3186-3188). Cmd+/ is bound at src/actions.rs:167.
- Nothing in docs/manual.md (337, 340-354) or the CHANGELOG Unreleased section (5-15) covers clickable rows.

**False: "the field's Change event already runs the search"**
- `InputState::set_value` suppresses the event. gpui-base-0.8.1/src/input/base/state.rs:1218-1247 says "no InputEvent::Change is emitted" and sets `emit_events = false`; the emit is gated at 4715-4717.
- Every existing caller pairs `set_value` with an explicit `set_query(.., true, cx)`: mod.rs:673-675, 821-823, 1352-1354 and filter.rs:233-235.
- As proposed, the field would fill but `self.query` would not change, so no search would run and the proposed test would fail.

**Not testable as written: "assert the first row's text"**
- The harness exposes accessibility properties, not rendered text (gpui-kit-0.8.1/TESTING.md).
- The row needs `.aria_label(..)`, as `status-text` does at bars.rs:392-396.

**Missed: closing the dialog on click lets a double-click open a file**
- A closing dialog stops occluding (gpui-component-0.8.1/src/dialog/dialog.rs:723-725).
- The second press of a double-click therefore lands on the result under the pointer, where `click_count >= 2` opens it on mouse-down (src/finder/views.rs:336-350, mod.rs:1655-1666).

**Missed: Contents mode**
- With the Contents chip on, the example would be grepped as file text (mod.rs:1373, 1398-1399, 2993-3006).

No existing test pins the static rows; tests/controls.rs:186-200 and 391-394 only click `help-done`. I did not run cargo; all of this is from reading the code.
verifier.implementation_notes:
All code changes are in src/finder/dialogs.rs; mod.rs needs no edit, because the child module can already reach `search_input`, `query`, `search_contents` and `config`.

**Design change: fill and run, but keep the dialog open.** This matches the app's other click-to-fill surfaces: Go to Folder matches (go_to.rs:92-99, 112-128), Batch Rename examples (batch_rename.rs:295-314) and Settings applying live behind its dialog (dialogs.rs:90-93). It also makes a double-click harmless, since the second click hits the same row.

1. Add a helper on `Finder`, `fn try_search_example(&mut self, example: &str, window, cx)`:
   - Normalise the example to single spaces: `example.split_whitespace().collect::<Vec<_>>().join(" ")`. ROWS uses two spaces for display.
   - Call `self.set_search_contents(false, cx)` (mod.rs:1478), because the table documents name search.
   - Call `self.search_input.update(cx, |s, cx| s.set_value(query.clone(), window, cx))`.
   - Call `self.set_query(query, true, cx)` (mod.rs:1323). This explicit call is required.

2. In `search_help`:
   - Take `let view = cx.entity();` before `open_dialog`, and change the builder to `move |dialog, window, cx|`.
   - Read `view.read(cx)` inside the builder for `config.search.typos`, `query` and `search_contents`. `save_smart_folder_dialog` does the same at dialogs.rs:877-884.
   - Mark which rows are examples with a third tuple field or a separate const, not `ix < 9`, so adding a row later cannot shift it.

3. Build every row the same way so the iterator has one type:
   - `h_flex().id(("syntax-row", ix)).px(ui(6.)).rounded(ui(4.)).aria_label(SharedString::from(format!("{syntax}: {meaning}")))`.
   - Then `.when(is_example, |row| row.cursor_pointer().hover(move |s| s.bg(hover)).on_click(window.listener_for(&view, move |this: &mut Finder, _: &ClickEvent, window, cx| { this.try_search_example(example, window, cx); window.refresh(); })))`.
   - End with `.test_support()`. Use `theme.list_hover` for hover, as go_to.rs:105/120 does.
   - `window.refresh()` is needed so the dialog layer rebuilds (same as dialogs.rs:92).

4. Feedback inside the dialog: give the row whose example equals `finder.query` (and `!search_contents`) a selected background, `theme.primary.opacity(0.14)` as at bars.rs:34. The results are partly hidden behind the dialog, so the row has to show that the click took effect.

5. First row meaning from `typos`: "Fuzzy words; every word must match (typos allowed)" or "... (typos off in Settings)".

6. Footer: start with "Click an example to try it." and keep the rest. Done, Return, Escape and the backdrop still close the dialog, and focus returns as today.

7. Docs:
   - docs/manual.md:354: add that clicking an example puts it in the search field and runs it, and the table stays open.
   - CHANGELOG.md, Unreleased, Added: one entry.
   - README.md:116 is optional.

**If one-click dismissal is wanted instead**
- Call `window.close_dialog(cx)` first and `focus_search` after it, because close restores the old focus (gpui-component-0.8.1/src/root.rs:447-453).
- Do not wrap rows in `DialogClose`; its deferred focus restore (root.rs:455-491) takes focus back after the exit animation.
- Add a guard for the double-click pass-through in `item_interactions` (views.rs:339). That makes it a three-file change.
verifier.test_plan:
Add one headless test to tests/controls.rs after `scope_bar_controls` (ends at line 395), e.g. `search_syntax_examples_run_a_search`, using the helpers in tests/common/mod.rs.

1. Open: `Fixture::new("syntax-examples")`, `Ui::open`, then `ui.press(&cmd("/"))` (or `ui.dispatch(SearchHelp)`). Assert `ui.dialog_open()`.
2. Typos text, on: `ui.snapshot(("syntax-row", 0usize)).label()` contains "typos allowed".
3. Click an example: `ui.click(("syntax-row", 2usize))` (the `*.pdf  *.md` row). Assert:
   - `ui.dialog_open()` is still true.
   - `ui.read(|f| f.query().to_string()) == "*.pdf *.md"`.
   - `ui.names() == ["Roadmap.md"]`. Extension constraints OR together and directories are filtered by the same test (fff-search-0.11.0/src/index/constraints.rs:283-296, src/score.rs:400-410, 608-625).
4. Double-click is harmless: `ui.double_click(("syntax-row", 2usize))`, then `ui.system_calls().is_empty()` and `ui.folder()` unchanged.
5. Non-example row: `ui.click(("syntax-row", 9usize))` (Kind menu) leaves the query unchanged.
6. Close: `ui.click("help-done")`, then `!ui.dialog_open()` and `ui.files_focused()`.
7. Contents mode: `ui.update(|f, _, cx| f.set_search_contents(true, cx))`, reopen, click row 2, assert `!ui.read(|f| f.searches_contents())`, close.
8. Typos text, off: `ui.update(|f, _, cx| f.update_search_settings(|s| s.typos = false, cx))` (no reindex; engine.rs:372-385), reopen, and assert the row 0 label contains "typos off".

Existing tests that must stay green unchanged: controls.rs:186-200 (`actions_menu_items`, "Search Syntax…" then `help-done`) and 391-394 (`search-help` then `help-done`).

verifier.risks:
- **Replaces the current query.** The (i) button only exists mid-search, so a click always overwrites what the user typed. `set_value` also clears the field's undo history, so Cmd+Z will not bring it back. Smart Folders behave the same way. `InputState::replace_all` (state.rs:1258) would keep undo, but it is unused in this codebase and also emits Change.
- **Most examples find nothing.** On a typical index, `"tax exemption"`, `/notes/ todo`, `src/**/*.rs` (anchored at the search location's root), `main src/`, `git:modified` and `main.rs:42` usually show "No Results" (mod.rs:3246-3249). Only `*.pdf *.md`, `!*.log !test` and sometimes `budget report` return items. That is acceptable but it is why the value is 2.
- **Other filters still apply.** Kind, the Nushell filter and scope are left as set, so an example can show nothing for those reasons.
- **Results are partly hidden.** With the dialog open, the 560 px dialog and its dim cover much of the list, so the row highlight is the main feedback.
- **Merge overlap.** Any other candidate that edits the ROWS table in `search_help` will conflict with this one.
- **Close-on-click variant.** If chosen, the double-click pass-through opens a file and records it for ranking unless guarded.
